posts.text: Iowa! What a game. What a win.

Go. Big. Orange. Great, tough win for Tennessee. That’s four straight Sweet 16’s or better for Rick Barnes at Tennessee. Prior to 2000 Tennessee had only been to two Sweet 16’s in program history. Vols have had ten Sweet 16’s since 2000. Still need the final four though!
There’s no way you can change that call.
